symptom_summary: VE/VF Commodore rough idle and cam/crank correlation fault
verified_fix: Replaced stretched primary & secondary timing chains and verified oil pressure >= 250 kPa at 2000 rpm.

symptom_summary: VF Commodore V8 intermittent misfire under load
verified_fix: Cleaned corroded engine block ground G106 and replaced faulty #1 ignition coil.

symptom_summary: FG Falcon ZF6HP26 limp mode and no PRNDL display
verified_fix: Replaced leaking transmission mechatronic bridge seal and cleaned 16-pin connector.

symptom_summary: Ranger PX3 DPF restriction warning and derate
verified_fix: Replaced split DPF differential pressure sensor hose, reset learned ash, and ran Tier B forced regen.

symptom_summary: Hilux GUN126 DPF efficiency fault on highway
verified_fix: Cleaned blocked 5th fuel injector nozzle and verified exhaust temp > 600C during static regen.

symptom_summary: BMW E90 fuel pump plausibility & long crank
verified_fix: Tested EKPS fuel pump module supply (13.8V) and replaced failing low-pressure fuel sensor.

symptom_summary: Triton MQ underboost and black smoke under load
verified_fix: Replaced split driver-side rubber intercooler boost hose and cleared learned MAF values.

symptom_summary: D-Max rail pressure drop and stalling at idle
verified_fix: Replaced worn Suction Control Valve (SCV) on HP3 pump and performed fuel pump learn.

symptom_summary: JDM Prius / Crown Hybrid warning light & cooling fan high
verified_fix: Cleaned clogged HV battery cooling blower fan and balanced weak NiMH cell block.

symptom_summary: Navara NP300 limp mode and turbo boost fluctuation
verified_fix: Replaced faulty turbo vacuum boost solenoid and cleaned MAF sensor.

symptom_summary: BYD Seal power system failure warning and sudden limp mode
verified_fix: Verified 12V aux battery (>13.5V DC-DC) and cleaned corroded rear-axle HV connector.

symptom_summary: Haval H6 / Cannon ESP light after wheel alignment
verified_fix: Centered steering wheel on flat ground and ran SAS Zero-Point Calibration + ESC sweep.

symptom_summary: LDV T60 DPF limp mode and low boost pressure
verified_fix: Replaced split intercooler hose clamp and ran Tier B DPF static forced regeneration.

symptom_summary: Grand Cherokee WK2 small EVAP leak MIL
verified_fix: Smoke-tested EVAP lines and replaced faulty ESIM purge integrity switch on charcoal canister.
